data.name: Corporate Climb
data.detailed_description:
This is a fast-paced online multiplayer arena game where movement is the key to victory. The game is built around a unique dual-swing movement system that allows players to move quickly across the map using momentum and skill. Every match is intense and competitive, and players must react fast, aim carefully, and use smart positioning to survive.

The main objective is not just to defeat enemies, but to complete a specific quota. Players must explore the map, avoid enemies, collect important items, and store them safely in their inventory. Only by gathering enough items and completing the required quota can the match be successfully completed. This adds strategy and teamwork to every round.

You can host and join matches through Steam lobbies and play with friends or compete against other players online. The gameplay focuses on skill-based mechanics, meaning there are no shortcuts or unfair advantages. Success depends on your timing, movement control, decision-making, and ability to survive under pressure.

If you enjoy high-speed action, competitive multiplayer games, and objective-based challenges, this game delivers an exciting and adrenaline-filled experience.

Break gravity. Survive the danger. Complete the quota.

With fully skill-based gameplay and intense competitive matches, survival depends on speed, precision, and smart decisions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1080p Low Settings, 30–60 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580 (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1080p High Settings, Stable 60 FPS
